title: smime-tree: test suite with OpenSSL oracles
description: Correctness must be verified against OpenSSL as the external oracle — never against this crate's own output. Generate test fixtures with: openssl smime -sign, openssl smime -verify, openssl smime -encrypt, openssl smime -decrypt. Hardcode fixture bytes as hex literals or committed binary files. Tests: verify() accepts OpenSSL-signed messages; decrypt() recovers OpenSSL-encrypted plaintext; sign() output passes openssl smime -verify; encrypt() output decrypts with openssl smime -decrypt. Cover both RSA and ECDH paths for encrypt/decrypt.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p smime-tree passes; all test vectors sourced from OpenSSL, not from this crate
